game_title: Flowchart Lab · Count up to n
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing, a river of molten rock: the volcanologist must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Exponent Engine: Use ** to power up engines: level 3 should deliver 2**3 energy.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing: a river of molten rock
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Read n. Print the whole numbers from 1 through n. If n is zero, print nothing. Test dataset 6: {'n': 0}; {'n': 11}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Exponent Engine' (Week 2 slot 11), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Lava River Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Collect 390 points of heat shields by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 390, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Exponent Engine – Lava River Crossing Rush
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
